_comment: Single source of truth for the tribunal-seat / dashboard / template model IDs. The drift gate (scripts/check-model-ids.py, audit-gates Gate 134) fails the build if any governed file references a token in `stale` or any claude-* id not in `current`'s values. Update `current` here (and regenerate the dashboards + copilot package) when a model is superseded; move the retired id into `stale`. See CLAUDE.md milestone 'Canonical model catalog + drift gate'.
_context_windows_comment: context_windows keys are the same aliases as `current` (opus/sonnet/haiku/fable), values are each model's real context-window ceiling in tokens, sourced from the claude-api skill's live model table (retrieved 2026-09-08): every current-generation Claude model is 1,000,000 except the haiku tier, which is 200,000. Consumed by scripts/context-usage-meter.py to resolve a session's real budget from its actual running model id instead of a hardcoded 200000 assumption -- see CLAUDE.md milestone 'Context-usage meter becomes model-aware'.

freshness_notes.opus_pin_2026-10-09: current.opus (claude-opus-4-8) stays the governed pin for drift gates and Claude Code first-party references; the live first-party/Bedrock `opus` alias may resolve newer. Copilot coding-agent top Claude was Opus 5.5 per the 2026-09 lineup — see substrate-tier-map.json hosts.claude._note and ai-coding-model-guidance cross-tool-model-lineup-2026.md.
